prompt: Granite, the speckled rock used for kitchen worktops, formed when molten rock cooled slowly deep underground. Granite is which type of rock?
explanation: Granite is an intrusive igneous rock. Slow cooling underground gave its crystals time to grow large enough to see as speckles.
